why: The floor under the tabbed component docs population. It may rise as a component gains a docs page, and never falls except by a hand edit that names the removal. Re-measure and raise it with `npm run check:docs-tabs -- --update`. Lowered from 80 to 71: Card, Divider, Collapse, Jumbotron, List group, Media object, Scrollspy, Nav pills and Navbar were retired and their docs pages deleted. Lowered from 97 to 95: Footer was deleted (no such component in the benchmark system) and User avatar was folded into the Sidebar pattern's account row, each taking its docs page with it. Lowered from 95 to 94: AiLabel was deleted, unused and replaced by the AI UI section.
